There is significant limb fusion and grounding issues, particularly with the rear pigs whose legs blend into shadows and foreground subjects. The pose auditor's high artifact risk score (0.65 low-confidence ratio) correlates with these visible structural ambiguities in the legs and snouts. Compression artifacts are also noted by the quality auditor.
key_defects: Limb fusion and poor grounding in rear pigs
Synthetic/airbrushed skin texture lacking organic detail
Structural ambiguity in leg placement (high pose uncertainty)
Taxonomy deviation: Blue skin instead of natural pigmentation
